decision.actually_tested_falsifier: GDT815 compares written carrier candidates and a named central motif under fixed property guesses, and demonstrates domain/polarity underdetermination. It uses no numerical semantic decision rule and executes no independent semantic falsifier selecting warm, cold or bitter; the historical examples are comparison context.
decision.claim: okaiin means warm, as a property rather than cold, bitter, possession or a copula.
decision.claim_ceiling: No isolated okaiin meaning has been selected. Q/R in GDT816 also differ at okol, so their comparison is not an isolated lexical intervention.

evidence.quote:
GDT814's N=powder?, G=is?, Q=warm? and R=possessive dessen? remain fixed, as
do the seven GDT813 shared guesses. K=cold? and B=bitter? are explicit additional
candidates, not new senses silently assigned to Q. B means literal taste.
The same f17r.11 therefore permits a conditional bitter/dry trial as well as
warm/dry and cold/dry. This demonstrates underdetermination, not three translations.

A useful historical counterexample is now explicit: the Archanum complexion
array makes Cancer cold/moist, whereas the medieval Latin Hugo Quadripartitum
II.13 describes Cancer as warm in a WEATHER frame. Its Book I also assigns
different powers to individual Cancer star groups. The latter transcription's
base witness is mid13th century, after1246; the former work is dated1295.
This is not a modern summer association. Nor is it permission to switch the
Voynich frame opportunistically at each occurrence. Primary citations and exact
editorial qualifications: src/ASTRAL_CARRIER.md. Source transcriptions were
consulted; their manuscript images were not independently collated this turn.

Aber erwärmtes Wasser beweist nicht humoral warmes Wasser: Magninus
unterscheidet tatsächliche Erwärmung von natürlicher Kälte. Damit ist der
physikalisch angenehme Wasser-warm-Satz kein übertragbarer Vorteil für den
gemeinsamen humoralmedizinischen Q-Versuch. Eine besondere Zusammensetzung
oder Wasserart ist bislang nicht gelesen und darf nicht eingeschoben werden.
[Magninus, Kapitel4, pp.168–173 und Editionsmetadaten](https://celt.ucc.ie/published/L600009B.html).

No frequency ranking, significance score or automatic semantic promotion.
Exact recurrence does not identify nouns, antecedents, owners or species. A
historical analogy motivates a candidate but does not decode it. Bitter is a
literal taste candidate and cannot silently become an astral medicinal effect.
Historical carrier and predicate frame remain separate from image recognition.
All13 word/model assignments are C0. Software checks are not semantic validation.

decision.outcome: Written chains supply possible carriers but not their meanings. Warm/dry, cold/dry and bitter/dry trials remain possible. Cancer can be cold/moist in one historical frame and warm in a weather frame. GDT816 physical warm-water plausibility cannot validate a humoral warm reading.

all_of: Establish both the source-owned referent and the predicate domain/frame by independent evidence rather than recognition of a neighboring motif alone.
Predeclare the same warm sense across target occurrences and discriminate cold/taste/possession alternatives without local sense repairs.
reopening.criteria_origin: Prospective reviewer synthesis from cited limitations; not an original-source preregistration gate.
reopening.interpretation: Prospective source-grounded review conditions, not a claim that required new evidence currently exists.
not_sufficient: Another matching property slot or historically plausible warm description.
Recognizing Cancer while its exact written owner remains open.
Switching between physical temperature, humoral complexion and weather at awkward occurrences.

scope_applicability.statement: Missing support for a shared warm sense/domain/polarity under GDT815/816. The broader okaiin=warm candidate remains unconfirmed, not rejected.
